referenceName: Feline-only clinic with three-action service gateway and compact care sequence

source.name: The Cat Clinic Edinburgh official website
source.sourceType: official direct veterinary-business website, captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance on 2026-09-29 covers retaining the paired desktop/mobile full-page captures, deriving a design prompt, and using these captures as internal pipeline-model visual references. No source-owner grant was supplied.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The specialist clinic uses two slim navigation rows, separating utility actions from primary topic links. Its desktop opening reserves broad negative space around a dark-blue type field, while the phone composition brings a close feline image behind a compact headline and registration action. Three large pale-blue action panels then clarify patient registration, routine appointments, and urgent information. A split chapter follows with a concise three-part numbered service rationale, then a deep-blue client-story area. Later, a quiet editorial text-and-image section, a contrasting local urgent-information band, and a small retail/resource feature lead to a compact footer. Translate the useful three-action gateway, feline-first photography, and calm step sequence only. Do not adopt the exact blue, source branding, photography, claims, reviews, award language, name, or wording.

heroGeometry.mode: negative-space desktop statement field and close pet-image mobile poster
heroGeometry.alignment: desktop content anchored left in a calm color field; mobile image and statement stack
heroGeometry.viewport: one-line service context and patient/appointment route remain immediately apparent

navigationGeometry.mode: two shallow navigation tiers separating patient actions from section links
navigationGeometry.mobile: brand and patient call controls collapse into a short help/menu row

typography.scale: compact display, strong section labels, restrained numbered micro-headings

palette.contrastIntent: gentle healthcare palette with clear text, borders, and distinct action states

imageTreatment.mode: close feline subject image within a calm environment
imageTreatment.crop: large mobile poster crop and separated desktop image chapter
imageTreatment.focalPoint: show the animal comfortably and reserve readable title space; never depict the source team as the new clinic

servicePresentation.pattern: three primary visit actions followed by three short care principles
servicePresentation.interaction: each action routes to a verified booking, registration, or urgent-care explanation

ctaPlacement.primary: book or register based on practice status
ctaPlacement.early: three action gateway follows directly after the hero

motion.primitive: optional client-story carousel with explicit previous, next, and position controls
motion.library: native CSS or framework primitives; no source scripts
motion.reducedMotion: present story items statically or with direct manual controls

mobileRecomposition.strategy: use a photographic feline opening, then stack three large actions and the care rationale
rules: preserve touch-sized register and appointment controls
keep emergency hours and eligibility accurate and explicit
do not force desktop negative space into an empty mobile panel

prohibitedPatterns: claiming feline-only status, specialist credentials, awards, hours, or emergency services without client verification
reusing source logo, precise blue palette, cat photos, reviews, copy, or local partner ads
using source testimonials as proof for another practice
empty oversized desktop hero fields caused by unavailable media
decorative numbered service cards unrelated to an ordered decision process

requiredSignatureElements.description: Three clearly distinct patient actions appear near the beginning, selected to match the actual practice.
A short ordered sequence explains clinic-specific care principles only when that order is meaningful.
A separate, visually distinct patient-story or factual proof chapter follows the immediate service actions.

acceptanceChecks: The opening distinguishes the actual patient and service scope without claiming feline exclusivity unless true.
The three action gateway routes to real booking, registration, or help destinations.
Numbered content describes a real sequence rather than decorative card numbering.
The mobile image crop keeps headline and action legible.
No source brand assets, photographs, story text, rating, credentials, opening hours, or local adverts are reused.

review.notes: Official site returned HTTP 200 at both requested viewports. It identifies an independent feline-only clinic in Edinburgh and exposes registration, appointment, and emergency-care routes. Cookie preferences were rejected in the disposable browser context. Full-page desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected; no broken content images or page errors were recorded.
